text: Exhibition Place employee(s) recognized by the Board for recent outstanding accomplishment: 1. 2020 United Way City of Toronto Campaign Ms. Catherine de Nobriga is recognized for her dedication and hard work managing the 2020 United Way City of Toronto Campaign for Exhibition Place during the COVID-19 pandemic. Each year in an effort to build a better city, the City of Toronto Public Service Staff, along with all Agencies, Boards, and Commissions participate in the annual city wide fundraising program in support of United Way Toronto & York Regions. This year, Exhibition Place raised a grand total of $600.00 for United Way City of Toronto Campaign. Over the last 16 years Exhibition Place have contributed a total of $89,602.10 to the United Way Toronto and York Region. 2. In light of the COVID-19 pandemic and many staff working remotely, we paused both the Employee Recognition Program…
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Applauded and extended congratulations to Ms. Catherine de Nobriga for her outstanding efforts on the 2020 United Way City of Toronto Campaign.
